decisions.reason: Selecting standout moments remains valid; the added complete-lesson-or-story and standalone-comprehension constraints are independently represented by the source Requirement and do not replace the candidate's source-selection attributes.
Requiring a complete lesson or story does not change the independent requirement that selected moments have effective hooks.
The teaching-moment change does not alter visual-editing state; message 119 separately modifies this candidate's editing style and effects policy through its existing same-message Event.
The source decision applies to the later requalification submission and does not modify the completed initial three-clip trial's count, source content, or acceptance condition.
The complete-teaching-moment change does not alter caption presentation; message 119 separately changes caption color, font, and effects through the candidate's existing same-message Event.

The batch still requires three perfect clips, and its existing same-message MODIFY already requires redoing all three after reviewing the revised guidelines; the teaching criteria need not be duplicated into the batch state.
Requiring each clip to contain a complete lesson or story does not change the independently specified 30-to-90-second duration range.
The source decision concerns the later requalification clips and does not retroactively modify the extended trial batch's quantity, source content, or guideline-compliance standard.
The added content-completeness criteria do not change the monthly target of 125 approved clips.
